name: Cable GigE, Cat 6, RJ45 sl hor/RJ45, DrC, P

sources.title: Basler Cable GigE, Cat 6, RJ45 sl hor/RJ45, DrC, P (Basler product documentation)
sources.covers: order numbers and lengths, connectors, cable diameter, minimum bending radius fixed and in a drag chain, bending cycles, drag-chain and robotics suitability

note: A twisted, shielded Cat 6 GigE cable with an RJ45 plug with horizontal screw lock at the camera and an RJ45 click-lock plug at the host, "suitable for drag chain applications". Stated: diameter "6.4 mm max."; "Minimum Bending Radius 40 mm, fixed installation | 60 mm, drag chain installation" (min_bend_dynamic_mm 60 is the drag-chain figure); "Maximum Bending Cycles 1 mio. cycles" ("guaranteed for 1 million bending cycles"; the test conditions are a figure on the page, not read as numbers); "Suitable for Drag Chain Applications Yes", "Suitable for Robotics Applications No" (drag-chain rolling, not the torsion of a robot joint). Lengths 5, 10, 20 and 25 m (2000027038, 2000028341, 2000027039, 2000029551). Not stated: the data rate (GigE is the camera's), mass.
